high_level_description: This image captures a dramatic and intense scene of a volcanic eruption at night. The focal point is the glowing lava and ash being expelled from the volcano's crater. The lava appears as bright orange and red hues, contrasting sharply with the dark, shadowy surroundings. The ash and gases rise into the sky, creating a thick, billowing cloud that dominates the upper portion of the image. The most striking feature is the lightning-like bolts of light emanating from the crater.
